title: Living Legacy: Sandkeep Endurance Raid
summary: Survive Sandkeep's endlessly replenished enemy field and earn enduring checkpoints through sustained pressure.
overview: Survive Sandkeep's endlessly replenished enemy field and earn enduring checkpoints through sustained pressure.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Distribute add control across the field and keep steady damage through each pressure window.
Treat Eothar as an anchor to control, not a kill target.

phases.label: Warmup
phases.description: Establish control of the enemy field during the opening 30 seconds.

phases.label: Pressure
phases.description: Meet each 12-second quota; five qualified windows earn the next checkpoint.

phases.label: Recovery
phases.description: Restore sufficient pressure during the 24-second recovery window or the expedition fails.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The captured raid contains 6 to 54 players. Eothar anchors a 27-enemy field with 26 killable enemies; defeated adds return after 12 seconds.
After a 30-second warmup, damage must satisfy repeated 12-second pressure windows. Five qualified windows advance the earned minute checkpoint.
A missed quota enters a 24-second recovery period; failing recovery ends the attempt.
Difficulty keeps increasing while earned reward checkpoints cap at model LXX. There is no conventional boss-kill victory.
A failed instance is terminal and requires a new expedition for another attempt.

notes: Approval E340. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
